about:
Absolute Packaging was established in 2001 in Springfield, Virginia, by packaging professionals focused on delivering responsible packaging development and product-specific packaging to the DC Metropolitan area. The company operates as a B2B support company serving a diverse client base.

The company designs and manufactures protective foam interiors configured for a wide assortment of products using a variety of cushioning materials. Its professional design engineers create packaging "from the inside out" with smart, innovative designs backed by a full line of advanced manufacturing equipment and proprietary systems. Services include custom foam design and fabrication, design and engineering, a customer stock program, custom box design, in-stock packaging, and wood crating and pallets. The firm also provides specialized packaging for art galleries and museums, with engineers holding over 31 combined years of experience in that niche.

Absolute Packaging serves the US Military, federal government agencies, bio-tech firms, electronics manufacturers, educational institutions, transportation companies, wholesalers, manufacturers, distribution companies, and art galleries and museums, including the National Archives. Its customer base spans the DC Metropolitan area and extends to companies across the USA through its design and engineering division.

The company states it is the only custom packaging solutions provider in Northern Virginia. Its designs are engineered to meet International Safe Transit Association (ISTA) drop testing specifications, including ISTA 1-A. A proprietary Customer Stock Program aims to eliminate storage and material delay issues for qualified businesses. Core values of honesty, professionalism, and respect underpin its approach to customer service.

Accutech Packaging operates from Foxborough, Massachusetts, where it serves as the North American representative for Beck Packautomaten, a German builder of high‑output packaging machinery. The company was established to provide tailored packaging solutions for mail‑order fulfillment, food processing, and general manufacturing, though its exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and manufactures custom packaging systems and equipment, and integrates third‑party machines such as Combi case packers, 3M case sealers, ID Technologies label applicators, and Sealed Air protective packaging systems into complete lines. It also stocks and delivers a full range of packaging materials from its warehouse using a dedicated fleet, and offers machinery service, technical support, and parts sales for brands including Markem‑Imaje.

Accutech’s customer base spans electronics, e‑commerce and retail, food manufacturing, and pharmaceutical and life sciences, with additional focus on food and medical packaging applications. Its team brings decades of experience across every segment of the packaging industry.

The company emphasizes a no‑cost consulting service, a team‑based approach that matches the right expert to each account, and a commitment to continuous improvement through quality management system compliance.

name: Accutron
old_description: electronic printed circuit board assembly. Our reputation is founded upon over 35 years
about:
Accutron operates from a 55,000-square-foot facility in Windsor, Connecticut. The company was established in 1989 and has built a reputation in contract manufacturing for electronic printed circuit board assembly. In September 2024, Accutron became part of Foxtronics EMS, expanding its capabilities and industry visibility.

The company provides full-service contract manufacturing spanning SMT and thru-hole PCB assembly, box build, engineering services including design for manufacturability and testability, component-level programming, and comprehensive testing through flying probe, in-circuit, functional, and burn-in platforms. A dedicated quick-turn prototype line supports rapid iteration, while material management and supply chain services streamline production from prototype to full-scale volumes.

Accutron serves aerospace, medical, and telecommunications sectors, holding AS9100 and ISO 13485 certifications alongside ITAR registration. Its web-based data collection system addresses Class III medical and aerospace traceability requirements, providing component-level lot control through full work order history by assembly number.

The company emphasizes simplifying complex technologies through a proactive management approach, competitive pricing, and swift time-to-market delivery. Its traceability infrastructure and quick-turn prototype capability are positioned as core differentiators for customers needing reliable, high-mix electronic manufacturing in the Northeast.

name: Accutronics, LLC
old_description: We are not just another EMS provider, but a true collaborative partner.
about:
Accutronics, LLC operates from Chelmsford, Massachusetts, where it was founded in 1984. The company has spent four decades building a reputation as a high-end electronics contract manufacturer, though its ownership structure and founding individuals are not publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in high-mix, low-to-medium volume electronics assembly, offering vertically integrated services that span printed circuit board assembly (SMT and through-hole), electro-mechanical box-build integration, cable and wire harness assembly, and comprehensive test services including SPI, AOI, flying probe, and functional test. Its facility houses dedicated new-product-introduction lines for rapid prototyping alongside production lines for repeat orders, enabling prototype-to-medium-volume runs without additional third parties.

Accutronics serves OEMs across medical devices, defense and military, aerospace and avionics, semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, robotics, IoT, and consumer electronics. The company is ISO 13485:2016 certified for medical-grade manufacturing and ITAR registered with DDTC registration M47838 for defense work, supporting customers from early-stage startups to mature programs requiring stringent quality and regulatory compliance.

The company differentiates itself through dedicated program managers who maintain proactive communication throughout the manufacturing lifecycle, a commitment to on-time delivery backed by streamlined logistics, and continuous investment in equipment and technology to maintain flexibility and precision. Its quality culture is reinforced by in-house personnel certified to IPC workmanship standards and a cage code (02M75) for government contracting.

Action Electronics, Inc. operates from Walpole, Massachusetts, where it has built over 30 years of operational excellence in integrated supply chain solutions. The company runs a 9,000-square-foot warehouse that is ISO 9001 qualified and operates around the clock, seven days a week.

The firm specializes in procurement, kitting and packaging, mil-spec packaging, inventory management, and custom delivery services. Its fulfillment capabilities include complex kit builds, premium packages, shrink-wrapped services, and in-chain packaging and product configuration. The facility ships more than one million pieces annually.

Action Electronics serves the aerospace and defense and telecommunications sectors. Its customer base includes federal, state, and local government entities, military contractors, and all branches of the U.S. military, which rely on the company for packaging, crating, and shipping needs.

The company emphasizes tailored solutions designed to reduce customer costs through value-added kitting, procurement consolidation, OEM-ready hardware kits, and engineered production and delivery systems. Its 24/7 operation and ISO-certified processes are cited as key differentiators.

about:
Action Solar is based in Lehi, Utah, and operates across 22 states. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders in the provided materials, nor does it specify an ownership structure such as family-, veteran-, or woman-owned.

The firm installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems and offers new-home solar solutions. In the past three years it has completed more than 2,750 projects totaling over 557 megawatts of installed capacity, delivering an estimated $1.41 billion in customer energy savings and offsetting 106 million tons of carbon. The process moves from consultation and site assessment through design, permitting, installation, and assistance with federal and local incentives.

Customers include homeowners seeking lower utility bills and higher property values, as well as commercial clients such as Walmart and Extra Space Storage that use solar to stabilize energy costs and improve sustainability profiles. The company also serves builders integrating solar into new construction.

Action Solar states its mission is to advance renewable energy by making solar power affordable and accessible, helping customers achieve energy independence and contributing to a universally sustainable future.

name: Actuated Medical, Inc.
old_description: Millions of patients with Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease, brain cancer, epilepsy, and other neurological disorders depend on therapies that must reach precise locations within the brain to be effective. NeuralGlider® is a validated precision brain access platform designed to improve target accuracy and support more effective delivery of brain-directed therapies.
about:
Actuated Medical, Inc. is based in Bellefonte, Pennsylvania. The company operates as a clinical-stage medical device developer focused on technologies for precise brain access.

The company's core product is the NeuralGlider® Precision Brain Access Platform, which uses electronically controlled ultrasonic motion to maintain trajectory during insertion through brain tissue. Preclinical studies have demonstrated precise delivery of AAV gene therapy to deep brain targets using smaller-diameter cannulas, resulting in healthier tissue at the insertion site and reduced drug reflux.

Actuated Medical serves the neurology, neurosurgery, and gene therapy sectors, targeting conditions such as Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, brain cancer, and epilepsy. Its platform is designed for use by neurosurgeons and researchers delivering brain-directed therapies, including drug delivery, implants, and gene therapies.

The company was founded to address what it describes as a fundamental bottleneck in brain therapeutics: the challenge of accurate delivery to precise brain targets. The NeuralGlider platform aims to improve target accuracy, reduce tissue trauma, and enable smaller-diameter access, thereby supporting more effective delivery across multiple brain-directed therapy categories.

about:
ADJ Sheet Metal Inc was founded in 2002 in White Plains, Maryland, roughly 30 miles south of Washington, D.C. The company operates as a custom sheet metal fabrication and installation contractor serving the Maryland, Virginia, and District of Columbia metropolitan areas, including Baltimore and Richmond. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

With a workforce of over 250 experienced sheet metal professionals, ADJ handles cutting (laser, water jet, CNC plasma, shearing), forming (press brake, rolling, stamping, bending), and joining (welding, brazing, spot welding, riveting) for projects ranging from rectangular and spiral lock-seam ductwork to custom HVAC cabinets, electrical enclosures, and UL-listed electrical boxes. In-house BIM coordination using Trimble software supports design-assist and construction planning.

ADJ serves commercial construction contractors, federal agencies, and mechanical and electrical trades across the Mid-Atlantic. Typical engagements include commercial special projects, tenant renovations, new construction, and federal building work. The company fabricates and installs custom ductwork, sheet metal fittings, and specialty items for HVAC and electrical systems, often collaborating on design-assist and providing estimating services.

The company’s stated mission emphasizes a safe, productive workplace and a commitment to customer service, reliability, technology, innovation, and integrity. Leadership positions ADJ as an industry leader focused on delivering quality fabricated products and installation regardless of project size.

about:
AdvaCare Pharma USA was founded in 2005 in Cheyenne, Wyoming, as an American‑managed pharmaceutical and healthcare company. The business began with a focus on delivering high‑quality, affordable medical products to distributors worldwide.

The company manufactures and distributes more than 4,000 branded pharmaceuticals, medical devices, dietary supplements, and veterinary products. Its medical device portfolio includes 500+ Class I and II devices across five divisions—AccuPoint injection instruments, AccuQuik diagnostic detection, StaySafe medical disposables, StayGuard skin and wound care, and StayDry incontinence and urology. Pharmaceuticals cover 500+ products in 13 dosage forms, supplements 150+ products in 9 dosage forms, and veterinary 250+ products in 13 dosage forms. Production occurs at GMP‑compliant facilities in China, India, and the United States, all certified to ISO and CE standards, with lean, flexible production lines that adapt specifications to distinct markets.

AdvaCare serves distributors, hospitals, pharmacies, NGOs, and government institutions in over 65 markets across Asia, Africa, North America, Latin America, the Middle East, and Europe. Long‑term distributor relationships in West Africa and other regions illustrate its customer base.

Its vested supplier‑distributor model yields an 88% retention rate, supported by regulatory affairs expertise that has registered thousands of products worldwide, plus marketing and logistics support at no extra cost.
